sources.targets: the pinned world SQL v0.9.296 through GroundDraft.World: the five weenies of the generator's slots with Name and Level: 235 Goldenback Tusker (49 slots) and 1627 Tusker Crimsonback (36) are targets; both Tusker Minions are level 40 and 22512 (40 slots) is KILL-FIRST because its spell book (weenie_properties_spell_book of the pinned SQL) holds ten spells, ids 60, 66, 71, 77, 82, 88, 94, 1050, 1309 and 1324 at probabilities 2.04 to 2.12, and it casts them at the player (60 is Acid Stream III, the seven bolts of the schools at III follow it in the local model's draft, checked against the pinned SQL); 22511 (19 slots) has no spell_book row, a melee Minion, and stays a plain target; the statue 22641 (level 171, 1 slot) stays avoid, its Use emote is the unwanted exit (spell 2936) and its slot cell is no-go. No creature of this ground holds a tusk (the pinned SQL's create lists have no destination 1 row under 235, 1627, 22511, 22512 or 22641; the tusk holders are in the other grounds, item 0's sel-tusks.tsv); roles: 235 target, 1627 target, 22511 target, 22512 kill-first, 22641 avoid. Stats from the GroundDraft run of M6 3 a1 over the same dump (each from the weenie's rows): max_health is ACE's CreatureVital.MaxValue (CreatureVital.cs:104-131 @95ef426d), weenie_properties_attribute_2nd type 1 init_Level + level_From_C_P + Endurance / 2 rounded half up (AttributeFormula.cs:55-71); magic_defence is ACE's CreatureSkill.Current (CreatureSkill.cs:154-163), weenie_properties_skill type 15 init_Level + level_From_P_P + (Focus + Self) / 7 for a trained skill, which is why it is above the bare skill row of the local model's sheets and of item 0's sel-creatures.tsv; attributes are weenie_properties_attribute types 1 to 6 init_Level + level_From_C_P; damage_types the OR of the body parts' d_Type; swing_s not drafted (TODO(f11-swing-seconds)) M6 16 Q12: the facts a target's from_bestiary names (any of max_health, magic_defence, xp, resist_health_drain) are read from the bestiary's tables (the same pinned world SQL rows) at load; the numbers each ground reads are unchanged (GroundCreatureNumbersTests).

sources.vendors: the outskirts profile's Holtburg rows verbatim (four, and since M6 14 Monyra the Jeweler's, below) in guid, cell, point, stop_cell, stop_point, buys_item_types and buy_price (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.vendors gives the stops and the price rule, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)), Vendor.cs 577-585 @95ef426d), with the 'sells' lists cut to the wares this profile uses (M6 3 F3 adds Cindrue's account-formula wares, each her create-list row, see components) (the loader refuses a ware that is no stock line, gear floor ware or trade note): Archmage Cindrue 2304 sells the scarabs and the Prismatic Taper of the stock, the Wand 2472, the four Mana Charges and the Trade Note (10,000) 2625 the purse lists (her other nine notes are not listed: the sells-equal-the-draft check prices a trade note at ACE's 1.15 only for a purse note) (the Copper Scarab 686, Value 100, 135, and the Silver Scarab 688, Value 250, 338, are her rows in the draft's town half); Thelnoth Cort the Healer 715 the Mana Potion 379 (230); Ecutha the Tailor 719 the Faran Robe with Hood 5851 (68); Shopkeeper Renald the Elder 718 buys the drops. Oolutanga's Refuge's Mage 22721 and Healer 22725 are the island's shop: TODO(m6-island-vendors), item 4's, never added as vendors here (D48) Shopkeeper Renald the Elder 718 also sells the Leather Gauntlets 56 (Value 1,100, 1,485 pyreals; armour level 130, burden 270, ValidLocations 0x20, ClothingPriority 0x8000, no wield requirement; his create list holds it in the pinned SQL): the gear floor's hand armour (M6 7 AH: a corpse run's replace step buys it when no worn piece covers the hands). M6 8 D (m5-side-packs-use, m5-pack-short): the Pack row of Shopkeeper Renald the Elder: SELECT weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 718 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id = 136 (one row, the world SQL v0.9.296); weenie 136 is a Container (ItemType 0x200, ItemsCapacity 24, PropertyInt 19 'Value' 65); price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x 65 - 0.1)) = 88. M6 14 T: Thelnoth Cort the Healer 715 also sells the Potion of Healing 377 (Value 170, 230 pyreals): SELECT weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 715 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id = 377 (one row, a SELECT on the world copy). M6 14 (m6-purse; live 2026-11-12: a level 39 mage's main pack stood full of rings, bracelets, necklaces and gems, the sale named each one outside every listed mask and the loot rule then left every corpse for want of a free slot): Monyra the Jeweler 716 is the outskirts profile's fifth Holtburg row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4020, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B40117, Archmage Cindrue's entry hall, point (157.19, 135.298, 66.12), buys_item_types 0x00040808 = Jewelry 0x8 + Gem 0x800 + PromissoryNote 0x40000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 716 (one row: 2056994848, A9B40117, 157.19, 135.298, 66.12, 264200, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-12). Her MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and her MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Novedion the Gem Seller 9423 (outdoors at (124.79, 31.52, 94.01), mask 0x808, MerchandiseMaxValue 25,000) is not listed: Monyra's walk is the one the dat tests confirm (VendorStopConfirmDatTests and ResupplyRouteDatTests walk every vendor of the den's profile, hers among them) and the outskirts, the Burrow and the Lodge list her already. M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the outskirts profile's row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Every other type of his mask is also Shopkeeper Renald the Elder's (0x480467A7), so he is listed after Renald: a tie of the loot buyers' counts goes to the profile's earlier row (ResupplyPlanner.LootBuyers), and that stays Renald. Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)).
sources.spell_plan: M6 3 p1, from the ladder rung 'temple-20-40' (ladder/war-mage.json, spell_level 4-4, element fire; M6 3 F1, 3-R2: the rung ends at 40, the portal's MaxLevel) and D41: character levels 32-40 cast Flame Bolt IV (41 base 240 is IV too, and belongs to the Abode rung, which holds the V crossing at 42). The crossing levels are SpellPlan.LevelAt (Mage/SpellPlan.cs) over SpellPlan.ProjectedWarBase at plan_cast_chance 0.95, read for every level 10 to 44 (level 15 base 139 is II, 16 base 145 is III; 26 base 191 is III, 27 base 194 is IV; 41 base 240 is IV, 42 base 243 is V; the skill a level needs is its power + 43: II 93, III 143, IV 193, V 243); the rows stay in the rung's band and do not overlap
sources.components: the foci formula, as the Temple 40+'s (GearKit.FociFormulaCounts over the dats' Flame Bolt formulas; HuntingGroundDatTests.A_dungeons_components_cover_the_war_lines_formula_at_every_spell_level_its_plan_names pins the foci formula): Flame Bolt IV (spell 83): 1 Silver Scarab and 3 Prismatic Taper; Flame Bolt V (spell 84): 1 Gold Scarab and 4 Prismatic Taper. M6 3 F3 (3-R10, closes TODO(m6-dungeon-account-formula)): the account formula of 'test' (SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount, read from the dats; what Winnie casts if she loses her Foci of Strife, HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488 @95ef426d) is carried beside the foci formula, as the outskirts carry it (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.components), for each spell level of the plan, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_dungeon_carries_the_account_test_formula_beside_the_foci_formula: IV (spell level 4): Silver Scarab, Pink Taper, Hawthorn, Blue Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman. Every coloured taper, herb, powder and talisman is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, weenie_properties_create_list, destination 4, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296; Value 25 tapers, 10 Hawthorn, 5 the powder, Turpeth and Talisman; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7); the scarabs are the foci formula's lines above.
sources.supplies: M6 3 p1, sized from the rung 'temple-20-40' as the outskirts profile was (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): the modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 246 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 5.2 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 1279 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt V as the worst case, 4 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 5116 tapers an hour. Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30): keep 900 = 10 minutes of that burn rounded up to 50 (capped at 1,000, a stack's limit; 6 burden each, and the capacity is the climber's Strength, TODO(m6-climber-strength)), trip_under 300 (a third of the keep), stop_under 5 (a cast needs 4). Scarabs (Cindrue: Iron 689 at 68, Copper 686 at 135, Silver 688 at 338, the draft's town half, Value x 1.35): the cap level's keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2; a lower level's keep 10, trip_under 3; no spell here burns more than ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 = 0.005 a cast (Flame Bolt II's 0.05, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d; III to V unmeasured, TODO(m6-component-loss-iii-v)), so 20 scarabs last 3.1 hours at 1279 casts an hour. The Gold Scarab 687 (spell V) is CARRIED: no Holtburg vendor sells it (Cindrue's wares in the draft's town half end at the Silver Scarab), so the line has no vendor, keep 20, trip_under = stop_under = 0 since M6 14 (live 2026-11-12 14:28 UTC: the ladder's character, never granted anything, came to this rung with none and the run stopped by the line's name before its first step; this ground's plan casts level IV, which burns the Silver Scarab, and nothing of it burns a Gold one, so the line stops no run; the Black Spawn Den's carried lines, D8, stop at 2 because its mage is handed its kit); where the climber buys it is TODO(m6-island-vendors), item 4's. The Copper Scarab 686 is on every spine profile at keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (the Temple 40+'s line): the four travel spells (Lifestone Recall and Tie, Primary Portal Tie and Recall) burn one a cast on the foci formula, and GearKit.CastBurns refuses a ground that cannot buy it (GrantsCountedTests). Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0, the outskirts' reserve. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 34,230 pyreals at the vendors' prices; purse: coin 35,000 (that rounded up to 1,000, the floor the coin is kept at as the outskirts' is), notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the surplus is kept as bonded notes: a death takes half the coin and no note, Player_Death.cs:347-360 @95ef426d), the one note listed is the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)). kit: none, as the outskirts' (the Pathwarden robe and the Training Wand serve; a kit line would put the ground into the level-80 buff-kit checks of GrantsCountedTests and MageBuildScenarioTests); the floor's Wand and Faran Robe with Hood stay sold by Cindrue and Ecutha for GearFloor; burden_trip_percent 150 as the outskirts'. M6 3 F3: the account formula's lines (herbs, powders, talismans, coloured tapers) are stock lines at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the outskirts' rule for them (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn, a rung's cost of about 250 pyreals the first restock, inside the purse (see components) M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: carry health drinks): Potion of Healing 377 (Thelnoth Cort the Healer; BoostValue 25 on Health, Value 170, burden 15; 230 pyreals by the price rule): keep 30, trip_under 6, stop_under 0, listed before the Mana Potion so a short trip budget fills it first. Sized from the live hits of 2026-11-11 in the Tusker Cave (886 hits, mean 3.79, the largest plain hit 9, criticals of 13 and 18; 8 to 11.6 health a second with a pack on her at health 114): a drink from the magic stance takes 2.5 s, so one Potion of Healing is 10 health a second, about what such a pack deals, and the 20 to 30 s a way out takes are 8 to 12 drinks; keep 30 is two to three of those and trip_under 6 is half of one (a trip the purse cannot pay is held back, LogisticsCounters.IsHeldBack). The fight drinks one only when the mana pays no heal or the next hit kills (HealthDrinks.Emergency), so the stock is a reserve and not a ration. Thelnoth sells no Health Tincture 27319 (50 health, 20 health a second): the nearest seller by the travel file is Ludora the Healer 2229 in Dryreach, a trip not built (TODO(m6-health-tincture-trip)); the Health Draught 2457 he also sells restores 10, 4 health a second, under what three tuskers deal, and is not stocked. The purse's coin is 42,000 (it was 35,000): the first fill of every sold line with the thirty Potions of Healing (6,900) stays inside the coin and the one note (HuntingGroundTests, the first-fill check).

fight.source: M6 7 AX (the rule audit, Part 2: fight null, as the Cave). pull_full_percent 100, pull_rest_until_percent 90, pull_rest_posture lie, pull_health_percent 70: as the Cave. pull_aggro_metres 25: VisualAwarenessRange (PropertyFloat 31) of Goldenback Tusker 235, the widest of the ground's fighters (Crimsonback 24, Minion 15), SELECT on the world copy. pull_mana_percent 85: Goldenback 130 health over Flame Bolt IV (the live mean of III, 64, x the SQL base 52/42, 79; never seen in a fight) is about 2.5 casts a kill at 20 mana (a planning value), 50 mana; a pack of 4 is 200, with 2 drains at 10, 220 of about 260 (the survey's pool at level 30), 85%. retreat_health_percent 40: Lifestone Recall, as the Cave; a Goldenback hits 1.989 times a Male Tusker. Nothing here covers the Minion's acid (TODO(m6-acid-protection)) and this rung has no gate of its own (TODO(m6-gate-past-the-cave)). All planning values: TODO(m6-temple-fight-live).
